articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jan. 15, 2026-- Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.88 per share, payable on February 19, 2026 , to shareholders of record on February 4, 2026 . View source version on businesswire.com :
articles.title: Graham Holdings Company Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend
